Fixed the belt routing bug! The issue was in the `Building` model in `models.py`. The port position and direction methods (`input_port_pos()`, `output_port_pos()`, `input_port_direction()`, `output_port_direction()`) were returning positions/directions as if rotation was always 0.

**Changes made to `src/satisfactory_planner/core/models.py`:**

1. Added `_rotate_point(px, py)` helper method - rotates a point around the building center by the current rotation angle
2. Added `_rotate_direction(direction)` helper method - adds the rotation angle to a direction in radians
3. Updated all four port methods to compute the base position/direction first, then apply rotation via the helper methods

Now when belts call `source.output_port_pos()` and `dest.input_port_pos()`, they get the correctly rotated positions that match where the visual ports are displayed. The belt routing will correctly follow the ports when buildings are rotated.
